body:
This has now been tried out in sufficient environments to convince me there's no breaking change in marking /es as a module:

* Next.js 12 (via React InstantSearch hooks)
* Next.js 11 (via React InstantSearch hooks)
* Vue InstantSearch via Vue CLI and Vue 2
* Vue InstantSearch via Vue CLI and Vue 3
* Create React App (via React InstantSearch hooks)
